messages:
maria: Quick Q — console UX: do we allow activation windows on variants? e.g., make a variant only accept traffic 09:00-17:00 local time for region to keep cost SLOs. ping @aj @devon

aj: We have a schedule field in the API proto but it's not surfaced in the console. Backend supports cron-like windows? is it per-variant or per-experiment? :thinking_face:

devon: runtime accepts an `activation_window` on a per-variant basis. shape we've used in internal tests: `activation_window: {start: \"09:00\", end: \"17:00\", tz: \"America/New_York\"}`. routing layer currently ignores windows when fallback policy triggers — fallback takes precedence.

leo: Heads up: if window closes and variant had 50% weight, that 50% gets redistributed instantly -> can spike fallback model qps and mess up telemetry. Need to ensure metrics attribute the shift and not double-count.

maria: Product wants a guarded drain: gradual ramp-down over X minutes instead of instant cut. Can we add `grace_period_seconds`? UI should show a 'scheduled' badge + next transition time.

aj: Backend can do gradual drain by reducing weight in N steps, e.g., every 10s decrement. But per-variant quotas complicate this: quota enforcement/consumption currently assumes static weights. Also quota TTLs are per-experiment, not per-variant, so draining might free quota unexpectedly.

devon: Proposed API additions: `activation_window` + `drain_strategy: \"linear\"|\"immediate\"|\"canary\"` + `drain_duration_seconds`. Example config:
```json
{
  "variant_id": "v2-green",
  "weight": 0.5,
  "activation_window": {"start": "09:00", "end": "17:00", "tz": "America/New_York"},
  "drain_strategy": "linear",
  "drain_duration_seconds": 300
}
```

leo: Telemetry hooks we should emit: `variant.scheduled`, `variant.drain_start`, `variant.drain_step`, `variant.deactivated`. Each event should include experiment_id, variant_id, prev_weight, new_weight, reason (window|manual|fallback), and region/tz when applicable. That'll let dashboards show expected vs actual traffic during transitions.

maria: UX ask: console should render a predicted traffic graph for next 24h given all schedules. Also a 'preview' button to simulate drain so PMs can see how weight evolves.

aj: Edge case: overlapping windows across regions. If a variant has multiple windows (or different tz overrides) we need to evaluate region first and then window. Also: requests with explicit override (admin test headers) should bypass windows.

devon: Implementation note for routing order (proposal): `explicit_override` -> `activation_window_check` -> `quotas/checks` -> `variant_weights` -> `fallbacks`. We'll flush this out in docs and RFC.

canary-bot: Deploy triggered: canary-router v2 -> 2024-11-05T12:03Z :rocket:

maria: Action items: @aj mock console UI for scheduled badge + preview, @devon design API + telemetry events, @leo define telemetry schema + dashboard panels. I'll sync with product on sensible default for `drain_duration_seconds` (recommend 300s). Thanks :thumbsup:

aj: I'll also draft a short RFC about routing evaluation order + example configs, link to PR when ready.

maria: If we can get a small e2e with simulated traffic, product can validate behaviour before we flip it on for self-serve experiments.
